Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, indicating a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and mild proteinuria are also noted. Low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy based on sensitivity testing.
